applicabilityBasis.summary: JPYSC is a yen-denominated Type III electronic payment instrument issued by SBI Shinsei Trust & Banking Co., Ltd. for payments and settlement. The September 30 contractual terms identify a holder payment claim against the issuer, Japanese-yen settlement and a value of one yen per JPYSC; the trustee publishes direct redemption procedures. The trustee expressly describes JPYSC as neither legal tender nor a deposit. Initial distribution remains confined to SBI VC Trade accounts, with external withdrawals unavailable.

genius.notes: Reviewed as of 2026-10-07. The issuer is SBI新生信託銀行株式会社; its homepage supplies the official English name SBI Shinsei Trust & Banking Co., Ltd., replacing the prior literal translation SBI Shinsei Trust Bank, Ltd. SBI VC Trade is the distributor and trust settlor, not the legal issuer. Japanese trust-based payment-instrument issuance does not establish a U.S. GENIUS approval, state qualification, foreign registration or U.S. issuer pathway. The negative finding is limited to the public sources and names listed below; unpublished filings are not excluded. No U.S. state issuing nexus was identified; NYDFS was reviewed as a state licensing/issuance inventory. Generic FSA framework material does not establish a token-specific issuer license, so licensingRegulator is omitted. The issuer-wide no-public-action-found claim is omitted rather than treating unrelated historic trustee action as token or GENIUS enforcement. No reserve, redemption-policy-presence or monthly-attestation booleans are added. Trustee HTML and September 30 terms were recovered through Jina after direct fetches timed out; the uniquely named browser attempt timed out before a managed tab was created. The contractual yen-redemption description does not guarantee reserve adequacy or principal recovery: the terms disclose reserve losses and no principal guarantee.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: The reviewed public federal inventory, Federal Register exact-name searches, NYDFS directory and issuer materials did not identify a qualifying U.S. GENIUS approval, official application, state-qualified approval or registered foreign-issuer exception for JPYSC or its named Japanese trustee issuer. This is a dated public-source finding, not proof that confidential filings do not exist. Japanese licensing and distributor registration are not U.S. GENIUS authorization.
